verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents a reference hub listing SDK packages and a CLI (docs-51), a REST API quickstart with copy-paste code (docs-1, docs-11), and per-product example pages for parse, extract, split and classify (docs-52, docs-32, docs-37, docs-38). Nothing shows an interactive API explorer, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 at every candidate path. missing for 10: an interactive API reference (try-it console or explorer), runnable in-browser examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of the reference experience.
